messages:
emma (PM): Quick post-launch triage — need to separate what goes in the next patch vs what goes to backlog. Quick signals: errors +3.8% last 24h, support tickets +18. Main asks: dropdown state bug + embeddings 95p latency spike. How do we want to prioritize?

noah (Support): Support: tokenizer dropdown resets on page reload — ~11 tickets, screenshots on a few. Majority on Safari. Users call this confusing, marking as P1.

raj (Eng): I can reproduce the dropdown issue locally. State key not persisted across reload, likely a small client bug. Estimate ~2 dev hrs + 1 QA pass. Can someone paste a repro?

noah (Support): repro steps: open model details > change tokenizer > refresh page. Tickets include console error sometimes (CORS-ish). Attaching user notes to the ticket.

lisa (Eng): Another signal: embeddings route 95th percentile jumped from ~450ms to ~1.2s in spikes. Looks like batching window increase during bursts — backend queue length spikes. Could be autoscale reaction lag or batching config.

carla (Data): Analytics: the latency spike affects mostly 3 enterprise customers. We logged 7 related incidents past 72h. Estimated revenue exposure ~ $2.1k/day. Chart: https://dash.internal/reports/emb-latency (internal)

emma (PM): Proposed triage heuristics for this release: any bug with >8 support tickets OR causing >=1% estimated revenue impact => patch release. Cosmetic/feature asks go to backlog unless champion + mock. Thumbs if you agree, or propose adjustments.

sophia (Design): For the tokenizer dropdown I can do a quick UX fallback — visible selected-state indicator and small animation to signal persistence. ~1.5 design hours + 1 dev. Happy to pair with Raj on quick fix.

raj (Eng): +1. I can take the dropdown fix in the next patch. Will add guard in state persistence and a small unit test. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

lisa (Eng): For embeddings latency I propose a canary: reduce batching window to 10ms for enterprise route and monitor 95p for 30m. If stable, roll to 100%. I can push the canary today during low traffic.

carla (Data): I'll create a dashboard alert: alert if embeddings 95p > 800ms sustained for 10m and notify #eng-runtime. Will also track customer-specific impact.

emma (PM): Action list: Raj owns dropdown fix (Sophia pairing), Lisa owns canary + rollback plan, Carla sets alert and dashboard, Noah to update and tag affected tickets. Let's meet 30m tomorrow 10:30 PT to review canary metrics. Any objections?

noah (Support): No objections. I'll send affected customers a heads-up that we're testing a canary and monitoring, will update support notes.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Post-launch triage review" — 10:30 PT tomorrow (event id 2067976520). Invitees: emma, raj, lisa, carla, sophia, noah.
